name: Portable long service leave
what: Register with the state's portable long service scheme, report each worker's service and pay the levy: in building and construction everywhere, and in cleaning or security in some states.
consistency_note: Each state and territory runs its own scheme, with its own levy and covered work.

basis.locator: s 31(1) (republication of 19/11/2025 (Long Service Leave (Portable Schemes) Act 2009 | Acts))
basis.quote: 31 Application for registration by employers (1) An employer for a covered industry must apply to the registrar for registration on the employers register not later than— (a) 1 month after becoming an employer for the industry; or (b) the end of any additional time the registrar allows

basis.source: Building and Construction Industry Long Service Payments Act 1986 (NSW)
basis.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
basis.quote: 16A Employer to notify Corporation of employment of workers An employer who employs a worker under a contract of employment must notify the Corporation of that employment within 7 days after the worker commences to perform building and construction work in New South Wales under that contract.

basis.source: Construction Industry Long Service Leave and Benefits Act 2005 (NT)
basis.quote: Registration (1) A person must apply to be registered as an employer within the time mentioned in subsection (3) if the person: (a) employs one or more registered employees to carry out construction work in the Territory
